Dr. Evelyn Thorne
Principal AI Solutions Architect & Enterprise Generative AI Lead
San Francisco, CA | evelyn.thorne@aiarch.io | +1 415-555-0196 | linkedin.com/in/evelynthorne-ai | github.com/evelynthorne-solutions

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Visionary Principal AI Solutions Architect with 10+ years of experience architecting enterprise Generative AI platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic workflow frameworks, and large-scale cloud ML infrastructure. Proven track record leading technical pre-sales and enterprise customer deployments across Fortune 100 enterprises, driving $24M in new AI contract revenue and cutting LLM token processing costs by 65%.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Principal AI Solutions Architect | CognitiveScale Enterprise | San Francisco, CA | 2021 - Present
- Architected and delivered 20+ enterprise-grade Generative AI and RAG solutions for Fortune 500 financial and healthcare clients using Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, and Qdrant.
- Engineered multi-agent autonomous system using AutoGen and semantic routing, automating 75% of customer support workflows and saving $3.2M in annual operational expenses.
- Implemented hybrid vector search, context compression, and caching strategies, reducing LLM token consumption by 65% and cutting query response latency from 3.5s to 600ms.
- Partnered with enterprise sales leadership as chief technical advisor, presenting AI architectural blueprints to CTOs and closing $24M in enterprise software contracts.
- Established enterprise AI Governance and LLM Security framework addressing prompt injection, data leakage, and compliance with EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF.

Senior Solutions Architect (AI & Cloud) | CloudVanguard Systems | Palo Alto, CA | 2017 - 2021
- Led cloud migration and ML platform deployment on AWS and GCP for 15 enterprise clients, deploying automated ML pipelines on SageMaker and Kubeflow.
- Designed high-throughput distributed computer vision inference pipelines processing 2M+ daily images on GPU clusters with 99.95% SLA.
- Delivered technical workshops, whitepapers, and keynotes at major AI industry conferences (AWS re:Invent, GTC, NeurIPS).
- Mentored a high-performing team of 10 Solutions Architects and AI Engineers.

EDUCATION
Ph.D. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) | Stanford University | 2013 - 2017
Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science | UC Berkeley | 2009 - 2013

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- AI & Generative AI: Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG Architectures, Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate), LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, EKS), Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, AKS), GCP (Vertex AI), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Triton Inference Server
- Governance & Security: AI Safety, Red Teaming, Prompt Injection Defense, Guardrails AI, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, SOC 2, HIPAA
- Architecture: Enterprise Architecture, Solution Blueprints, Pre-Sales Consulting, Technical Leadership, System Scalability

CERTIFICATIONS
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional (2022)
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (2023)
- AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty (2021)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Principal AI Solutions Architect to lead enterprise AI transformation. Requirements:
- 8+ years experience as a Solutions Architect or Lead AI Engineer in enterprise environments.
- Deep expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, Vector Databases, and Azure OpenAI/AWS Bedrock.
- Proven pre-sales track record presenting to executive leaders (CTO/CIO) and closing enterprise deals.
- AWS or Azure Solutions Architect Professional certification required.
